import unittest
import pytest
from conftest import trace


@unittest.skip("whole-class-skip")
class ClassSkipped(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        trace("must-not-setup-skipped-class")

    def test_body(self):
        trace("must-not-run-skipped-class")


class OutcomeCases(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        trace("outcome-setUp", method=self._testMethodName)
        self.addCleanup(trace, "outcome-cleanup", method=self._testMethodName)

    def tearDown(self):
        trace("outcome-tearDown", method=self._testMethodName)

    @unittest.skip("method-skip")
    def test_decorated_skip(self):
        trace("must-not-decorated-skip")

    def test_runtime_skip(self):
        self.skipTest("runtime-skip")

    @unittest.expectedFailure
    def test_expected_failure(self):
        self.fail("expected-body-failure")

    @unittest.expectedFailure
    def test_unexpected_success(self):
        trace("unexpected-success-body")

    @pytest.mark.xfail(reason="pytest-marked", strict=True)
    def test_pytest_xfail(self):
        self.fail("pytest-marked-failure")


class SetupSkipped(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.addCleanup(trace, "setup-skip-cleanup")
        self.skipTest("setup-runtime-skip")

    def tearDown(self):
        trace("must-not-teardown-after-setup-skip")

    def test_body(self):
        trace("must-not-run-after-setup-skip")
